The '''Refreshment Bubble''' was a part of the [[City Bigspace]], a public concourse within the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Otoh Gunga/Legends|Otoh Gunga]]. Featuring a wide variety of restaurants and food vendors, the bubble aimed to cater to every taste imaginable.
